method.estimator: geometric mean + Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance, 252-day annualised
method.expected_returns: the average return over the whole training window
method.tangency: frontier._solve max_sharpe at the cutoff's ^IRX yield
caveats: the test windows are nested, so the cutoffs are not independent trials
the universe is 478 instruments that exist today with quotes back to the start date, so every asset tested survived the period
no transaction costs, no taxes, no slippage

SPY is priced but not investable: it is in the panel so its returns and its forecast volatility can be measured, and held out of the candidate set so the optimiser cannot buy the thing it is being compared against
method.window: 4.0y training window ending 3.0y back, held forward 1, 2, 3 years -- NESTED, so one trial reported at several points rather than several trials
method.rolling: 4.0y training window walked forward in non-overlapping holding periods over the last 3.0y
